Almost all of the useful features are locked behind a subscription, with the developers seemingly hoping users will be willing to pay every single month and in this economy and inflation it is simply just not realistic or possible. It preys on insecurities to make you spend so much money which you can’t even complete in a one off payment.  Instead, users are expected to essentially rent access to an app they could previously purchase outright and may i add not a cheap rent - it’s more expensive than a gym membership weekly. This feels greedy and disrespectful to the people who supported and loved the original Facetune.

It’s also incredibly misleading when your responses to reviews repeatedly claim that Facetune 2 is “free.” Yes, downloading the app is free, but you can barely use any of its worthwhile features without paying.

It’s incredibly disappointing to see such a great app turn into what feels like a constant push for more money.

I’m sick of companies treating people this way. This is manipulative, unethical, and reeks of a company that knows its product can’t stand on its own — so it tricks people into paying instead.
